app.name: Truecaller: Caller ID & Block
app.description: Caller ID and spam blocking app with global phone number lookup.

verdict.one_liner: Truecaller collects extensive device and usage data, including your location, call logs, installed apps, and advertising ID, and shares it with third parties for targeted ads.
verdict.summary: Truecaller collects a wide range of personal and device information including your location, IP address, device identifiers, installed apps, call and message metadata, and advertising ID. This data is shared with third-party advertising and analytics partners. The iOS app does not share your contact information with others, but it does collect it. Users can delist their number and opt out of ad targeting through device settings.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Truecaller collects extensive data about your device, calls, messages, and location, and shares it with third parties for advertising. Consider whether caller ID convenience is worth this level of data collection.

red.title: Truecaller collects a wide range of device and usage data
red.plain_english: Truecaller's privacy policy explicitly lists extensive data collection including your geo-location, IP address, device ID, installed apps, advertising ID, call and message metadata, and paired devices.

red.title: Your data is shared with third parties for targeted ads
red.plain_english: Truecaller shares personal information with third-party clients, agencies, and networks who may use it for analytical and marketing purposes, including targeted advertising.

red.title: Your location is used for interest-based advertising
red.plain_english: Truecaller states it may use your location and other collected information to provide location and interest-based advertising and marketing messages.

red.title: Call and message metadata is collected
red.plain_english: Truecaller collects logs, keywords, and metadata of your incoming and outgoing calls and messages. The policy does not clearly explain how long this data is retained.

red.title: Truecaller checks what apps are installed on your device
red.plain_english: The policy explicitly states that Truecaller collects information about applications installed on your device. It does not clearly explain why this is needed for caller ID functionality.

green.title: You can permanently unlist your number
green.plain_english: Truecaller states that users can permanently unlist their number from the Truecaller database.

green.title: You can download a copy of your data
green.plain_english: Truecaller states that users can download an entire copy of the data the company holds about them.

green.title: You can opt out of ad targeting
green.plain_english: Truecaller states that users can limit or opt out of the collection and use of their information for ad targeting through their device settings.

green.title: iOS app does not share your contacts with others
green.plain_english: The policy explicitly states that for apps obtained from the Apple App Store, Truecaller does not share any user contact information with other users.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention camera or microphone access.
categories.detail: The full Rest-of-World privacy policy does not explicitly address camera or microphone usage.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Truecaller collects your geo-location and uses it to provide location and interest-based advertising.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly lists geo-location as collected data and states it may be used for location and interest-based advertising and marketing.
categories.policy_excerpt: geo-location... We may use any of the information collected, as set out above, to provide You with location and interest based advertising, marketing messaging, information and services.
concerns: Location data collected continuously
Location used for targeted advertising

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Truecaller collects access to your device address book. For the iOS app, the policy states this contact information is not shared with other users.
categories.detail: The policy states that access to the device address book is collected during installation and use. For apps from the Apple App Store, Truecaller explicitly states it does not share user contact information.
categories.policy_excerpt: access to device address book... Where the Truecaller App is obtained from Apple App Store or Google Play, we do not share any user Contact Information.
concerns: Device address book is accessed
Contact information is collected even if not shared on iOS

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Truecaller collects information about applications installed on your device, device logs, and metadata from your calls and messages.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly lists applications installed on your device, device log and event information, and logs, keywords and metadata of incoming and outgoing calls and messages as collected data.
categories.policy_excerpt: applications installed on your device; ID for advertising; ad data, operating system; web browser; operator; IMSI; connection information; screen resolution; usage statistics; default communication applications; access to device address book; device log and event information; battery levels of the device; logs, keywords and meta data of incoming and outgoing calls and messages
concerns: List of installed apps is collected
Call and message metadata is logged
Device logs are collected continuously

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Truecaller shares personal information with third-party clients, agencies, and networks for analytical and marketing purposes, including targeted advertising.
categories.detail: Section 3 explicitly states that Truecaller shares personal information with third party clients, agencies and networks who may use it for analytical and marketing purposes, including targeted ads, fraud detection, and improving their products.
categories.policy_excerpt: Truecaller may also share personal information with third party clients, agencies and networks. Such third parties may use this information for analytical and marketing purposes, including but not limited to providing measurement services, targeted ads, fraud detection, for improvement of their products and services.
concerns: Personal information shared with third-party advertising networks
Third parties may use data for targeted ads
Data transferred across countries including India

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Truecaller requires your phone number, name, and optionally collects photo, gender, address, email, and social media profiles. It may also supplement your data with information from third parties.
categories.detail: Section 1.1 states that creating a profile requires first name, last name and phone number. Optional information includes photo, gender, street address, email, Facebook page, Twitter address and status. Truecaller may supplement this with information from third parties.
categories.policy_excerpt: In order to create a user profile, You must register Your first name, last name and phone number... Additional information that may be provided at Your option include, but is not limited to, photo, gender, street address and zip code, country of residence, email address, professional website, Facebook page, Twitter address and a short status message. Truecaller may supplement the information provided by You with information from third parties
concerns: Identity data enriched from third-party sources
Social media profiles linked to phone number
Extensive optional profile data collected

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Truecaller collects your advertising ID and usage data, and uses it along with your location to provide interest-based advertising. Third-party partners also use cookies for targeted ads.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states Truecaller collects ID for advertising and ad data. It uses collected information for location and interest-based advertising. Third parties use cookies and similar technologies for targeted ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: ID for advertising; ad data... We may use any of the information collected, as set out above, to provide You with location and interest based advertising, marketing messaging, information and services. We may also use the collected information to measure the performance of our advertising and marketing services.
concerns: Advertising ID collected continuously
Interest-based advertising explicitly used
Third-party ad tracking through cookies

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Truecaller states its services are not intended for minors and it does not intentionally collect personal information from anyone under the age of consent.
categories.detail: Section 7 states the services are not intended for minors, Truecaller does not intentionally collect personal information from anyone under the relevant age of consent, and encourages parental supervision.
categories.policy_excerpt: Services are neither intended for nor designed to attract anyone under the relevant age of consent to enter into binding legal contracts under the laws of their respective jurisdictions. Truecaller does not intentionally or knowingly collect personal information through the Services from anyone under that age.
concerns: No explicit age verification mechanism described
Relies on parents to supervise minor use

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Truecaller collects your IP address, operator information, IMSI, connection details, pages you visit, content you view, and ads you engage with.
categories.detail: Section 1.2 explicitly lists IP address, operator, IMSI, connection information, pages visited, features used, services engaged with, content viewed, and ads seen/engaged with as collected data.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your IP address; operator; IMSI; connection information; the pages You visit and features you use on the Services; the services and websites You engage with from the Services; content viewed by You, content You have commented on or sent to us and information about the ads You see and/or engage with; the search terms You use
concerns: IP address and IMSI collected continuously
Browsing and ad engagement tracked
Search terms logged

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Truecaller collects extensive device information including your device ID, manufacturer, hardware settings, SIM usage, installed apps, advertising ID, screen resolution, battery level, and paired devices.
categories.detail: Section 1.2 lists device ID or unique identifier, device manufacturer and type, device and hardware settings, SIM card usage, applications installed, ID for advertising, screen resolution, battery levels, and paired devices as collected data.
categories.policy_excerpt: device ID or unique identifier; device manufacturer and type; device and hardware settings; SIM card usage; applications installed on your device; ID for advertising; screen resolution; battery levels of the device; Your paired devices (such as smart watch)
concerns: Unique device identifier collected
Advertising ID collected
List of installed apps collected
Paired devices detected

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The full Rest-of-World privacy policy does not explicitly address health or biometric data collection.
concerns: Policy is silent on health and biometric data

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Truecaller mentions payment services and facilitating payments through third-party providers, but does not explicitly state that it stores payment card details itself.
categories.detail: Section 1.3 mentions third-party payment services. Section 3 mentions facilitating payments through trusted vendors. The policy does not explicitly describe financial data collection for the core caller ID service.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may provide us with Your user identifier information regarding, or to enable Your usage of, certain third party services (together with a mapped photo where applicable) e.g. social networking services and payment services... facilitating payments as well as potential partners
concerns: Payment services mentioned but not clearly explained

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Truecaller states that users can restrict processing, disable optional permissions, download their data, permanently unlist themselves, and request deletion of their personal information.
categories.detail: Sections 4 and 6 describe delisting, opting out of ad targeting, disabling Enhanced Search, requesting correction or deletion, and downloading a copy of personal data.
categories.policy_excerpt: Each user is able to restrict processing of their data, to disable any of the optional permissions, to download an entire copy of their data or to permanently unlist themselves... When required by applicable law, You have the right to know what personal information is stored about You and to have any such information corrected or deleted on Your request.
concerns: Opt-out requires using device settings rather than an in-app control
No clear time frame given for data deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Truecaller states it will notify users by push notice or in-app notice for substantial policy changes. Your continued use after notification counts as consent.
categories.detail: Section 8 states that in case of substantial changes, Truecaller will notify users by push notice or via notice in the Services. Continued use after such notice constitutes consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: In case of substantial changes, Truecaller will notify the Users by push notice or via notice in the Services. Your continued use of the Services after a notice of changes has been communicated to You or published on our Services shall constitute consent to the changed policy.
concerns: Only substantial changes trigger notification
Continued use equals consent to changes
